card.name: Linking words in medical titles and citations
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'of', 'or' and 'as', or a word ending like 'osed', in the middle of a medical phrase. Typical places are academic titles before a specialty (professor of dermatology), journal citations (Am J Kidney Dis) and symptom lists.

modes.label: Title before specialty
modes.description: The word 'of' after professor or department, before a medical field.
modes.example: a clinical professor<< of>> dermatology at New York University

modes.label: Symptom lists
modes.description: A linking word inside a list of symptoms or signs, such as 'or' after 'photophobia,'.
modes.example: mass effect such as headache, photophobia,<< or>> visual field defects.

modes.label: Citation or word ending
modes.description: The abbreviation J in a journal name, or the ending 'osed' in 'undiagnosed'.
modes.example: Wall, SM et al: Am<< J>> Kidney Dis 28(6
